title: Understanding Model Variance
text: Model variance refers to how much the predictions of a model will change if we use a different training dataset. It is influenced by the complexity of the model.

title: Impact of Regularization
text: Regularization techniques, such as Lasso or Ridge, can impact model variance by penalizing large coefficients, which can reduce overfitting.

title: Role of Model Complexity
text: Increasing model complexity generally increases model variance because the model can fit the training data more closely, potentially capturing noise as well.

hintAnswer: Model complexity and lack of regularization can increase model variance.
title: Factors Affecting Model Variance
text: Which factors can increase model variance?
choices: Model complexity and lack of regularization can increase model variance.
